content:
**Visual observations from test image:**
- Soybean leaf showing scattered yellowish-orange discoloration across the surface
- Tiny pin-point lesions/pustules visible as small dark dots
- Mottled orange-yellow pattern distributed across the lamina
- Some small holes (shot-hole effect) visible
- Background leaves also showing yellowing

**Analysis:**
The scattered, fine yellowish-orange spots distributed diffusely across the leaf surface are characteristic of **Soybean rust** (*Phakopsora pachyrhizi*). The pattern shows:
- Small angular to irregular yellow-orange lesions across the blade
- The rust pustules are the small dark pinpoint structures visible
- The diffuse yellowing without large necrotic blotches or distinct margins rules out bacterial diseases
- Not Cercospora (which has distinct circular spots with tan centers)
- Not Frogeye (which has distinct gray centers with dark borders)
- The field context (background leaves also yellowing) matches rust spread pattern

The reference collage confirms rust causes field-wide yellowing with tiny pustule spots, matching the test image well.
